t: A very fast microcontroller family for sound, screens and simple vision.
steps: Buy an Arduino GIGA R1 WiFi from the Arduino store or a maker shop.
Get a USB-C cable that carries data.
Install the free Arduino IDE on your computer.
Open the Boards Manager and add the board package for the GIGA.
Plug in the board and pick Arduino GIGA R1 WiFi from the board menu.
Open the Blink example and press Upload. The colored light on the board starts to blink.
Try a Wi-Fi example next to connect the board to your home network.
meta: Wild Open. From $30.45. A few stores.
